description: The reclaim rows of ImpAI's handicap exemption (rows 11 and 12, the reclaim payout 0x4238C4 energy and 0x423918 metal; row 17, the reclaimed unit's credit 0x486CDA), applied by tools/impai/handicap_check.py to impai-handicap.json after impai-handicap-economy.json and impai-handicap-purge.json, keeping every unit already there: for each computer seat -- seat 1 OTA AI, seat 2 ImpAI -- one CORE construction kbot beside a Dragon's Teeth feature (8 metal, so its reclaim pays 20 ticks after it starts: the countdown 15 + (energy + metal) / 2, two a working call, engine/orders.md) and another beside a radar tower (CORRAD, 2 x 2, 50 metal, build time 1137) of its own seat, each ordered to reclaim it. The unit is no Dragon's Teeth: a Dragon's Teeth unit cannot be the unit: its FBI has isfeature 1 (CORDRAG, ARMDRAG), and the create of a finished unit with isfeature sets its death kind +0xF5 to 7 and +0x110 bit 14 (0x486161..0x486171), which the unit tick's reaper turns into a death and a feature at once (0x48AFB9..0x48AFD1). Both payout compares run whatever the feature's values (0x4238B3..0x423918, DISASSEMBLED). Each seat's four stand in the part of its economy box that impai-handicap-economy.json leaves empty: seat 1's in x 7040..7184, z 1720..1872 of the box round (7024, 1712), east of the wind generator and the extractor and south of the metal maker; seat 2's in x 5864..6008, z 6740..6904 of the box round (5848, 6744), placed the same way. Both boxes are dry and flat (impai-handicap-economy.json, read from the map's attribute grid). The stock AI's builder planner reorders seat 1's kbots every 90 ticks; handicap_check.py re-issues each reclaim every 45 ticks until its row has counted the seat.
